patches.entity_key: French verbs without preposition where English requires one
value: The verb agrees with its subject in person and number
The direct object does not change the verb form in simple tenses

evidence.notes: Standard verb agreement; the rule itself concerns the absence of a preposition.

value: With être as auxiliary, the past participle agrees with the subject
With avoir, the participle agrees only with a preceding direct object

evidence.notes: Standard compound-tense agreement applied to the futur antérieur.

value: The future verb agrees with the subject in person and number
The future forms mark no gender agreement
